title: Generate with structural video control
summary: Apply the official MiniMax H3 Fun Control model patch to a target generated by H3 while CAUCE exposes clip fitting and packed-sequence cost without changing model behavior.

inputs.name: source_video
inputs.cardinality: 24 fps source behind an inpaint mask

inputs.name: mask
inputs.cardinality: one or more spatial masks; 1 regenerates

constraints.control_fit_rule: truncate tail or repeat final frame; bilinear resize and center crop

graph_contract.role: create prompt conditioning and the target packed AV latent for non-reference variants
create reference conditioning and the target packed AV latent for the gated reference-control variant
report exact temporal and spatial fitting before applying control
load the official H3 Fun Control union patch
attach structural control, inpaint source/mask, strength, and sampling interval to the H3 model
report the exact multimodal attention row count before sampling

variants.mask_semantics: 1 regenerates; current official implementation thresholds at 0.5

evidence.summary: Official control support is merged in ComfyUI; this contract remains offline until the laboratory runtime exposes the node, patch weights, and required upstream fixes.
